note: Recorded shapes for modelrack.providers.ollama's conformance and unit tests (spec §19: a provider version bump triggers re-capture and a changelog note). Fixture bodies here are representative payloads matching Ollama's documented API for this version, not a byte-for-byte capture from a running server. tests/live/test_ollama_live.py is what proves these shapes against a real one.
re_annotation_note: ADR-0070 (row C5) added chat_complete_no_counts.json — a terminal payload with neither prompt_eval_count nor eval_count, which is this protocol's analogue of a response with no usage object and the only way to reach the all-UNSUPPORTED conformance case. This is a re-annotation, not a re-capture: no existing payload changed and the provider version did not move, so spec §19's re-capture trigger did not fire. The adapter's reading of prompt_eval_count was verified live against Ollama 0.32.13 on this machine on 2026-09-03 rather than inferred from these fixtures — two back-to-back /api/chat requests to gemma3:latest sharing a ~5 400-token prefix both reported prompt_eval_count 5410 while prompt_eval_duration fell from 885 ms to 126 ms, so the field reports the prompt submitted and not the tokens evaluated. A recorded fixture could not have answered that question, which is why _ollama_wire.read_usage's docstring cites the measurement rather than these files.
